scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I came here because I wanted to express my gratitude.
Thanks to you, things have gotten better...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我来这里是想表达我的感激之情。
多亏了你，情况好转了许多...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
However, not everything is going as expected.
I think I may have to take Peter's place instead.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
不过，事情并没有完全按预期发展。
看来我可能不得不接替彼得的职位。

scripts.text: What does that mean?
scripts.translation: 这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It appears I'm next in line to the throne.
This is not what I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
看来我是王位的下一位继承人。
这并不是我所希望的。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Everyone else has a better right to the throne, they're natural and qualified for it.
This is quite strange and unfamiliar to me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
其他人更有资格继承王位，他们天生就具备相应的资质。
这对我来说非常陌生，也很不习惯。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I've been in some discussions with the Schwarz's government, so I'll be busy for a while...
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
我最近一直在与施瓦茨的政府进行会谈，所以接下来一段时间会很忙...

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
It seems to me they like this arrangement.
I believe the relationship between our two countries will be maintained in the future thanks to our efforts.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
看起来他们很乐意接受这种安排。
我相信，由于我们的努力，两国之间的关系在未来将得以维持。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
If you still plan on attacking other enterprise facilities, you may want to rest first.
For the time being, you will need strength.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
如果你还打算攻击其他企业设施，建议你先休息一下。
目前，你需要保持体力。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I hope you'll keep on going.
Thank you again for all the help.
I have to go now.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
希望你能坚持下去。
再次感谢你的帮助。
我现在得走了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Hold on!
We have recently expanded the field of operations.
Due to this expansion, we've been able to set up a new base in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
等一下！
我们最近扩大了行动范围。
由于这次扩张，我们得以在艾音布罗克设立了一个新基地。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Let me revel to you the new bases location.
not far from the Einbroch railway station... there's a small bar called <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>einbroch,302,329,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, the next operation will be carried out there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
让我告诉你新基地的位置。
就在艾音布罗克火车站附近...有一家名为<NAVI>[猫在子弹上]<INFO>einbroch,302,329,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>的小酒吧，下一次行动将在那里进行。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I've delivered the information!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我已经把情报送出去了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
It's a small bar next to the train station of Einbroch.
<NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>einbroch,302,329,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>. Don't you think it's a cute name for a pub?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
那是艾音布罗克火车站旁边的一家小酒吧。
<NAVI>[猫在子弹上]<INFO>einbroch,302,329,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。你不觉得这对酒吧来说是个很可爱的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Oh! Welcome back!
How are you doing lately?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
哦！欢迎回来！
你最近过得怎么样？

scripts.text: We found an entry.
scripts.translation: 我们找到了入口。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I see... There was an entrance...
Sorry for the trouble.
I'm heading back to Cat on Bullet and I'll be resting a bit.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
原来如此...那里有个入口...
抱歉给你添麻烦了。
我要回“猫在子弹上”了，打算休息一下。

scripts.text: About Dien.
scripts.translation: 关于迪恩。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Dien is having a cup of tea on the second floor, in her room.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
迪恩正在二楼的房间里喝茶。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Dien is having a cup of tea on the second floor, in her room.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
迪恩正在二楼的房间里喝茶。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
What? I'm busy right now!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
什么？我现在很忙！

scripts.text: - It contains an envelope. -
scripts.translation: - 里面有一封信。 -

scripts.text: Take a look.
scripts.translation: 看一看

scripts.text: Just take it.
scripts.translation: 直接拿走

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text: - It's an old picture with people you've met before. -
scripts.translation: - 那是一张旧照片，上面有您见过的人。 -

scripts.text: - I took the picture with me, let's give it back to Dien. -
scripts.translation: - 我把照片带在身上，把它还给迪恩吧。 -

scripts.text: - Carefully closed the box again. -
scripts.translation: - 小心翼翼地重新合上盒子。 -

scripts.text: - I took the picture with me, let's give it back to Dien. -
scripts.translation: - 我把照片带在身上，把它还给迪恩吧。 -

scripts.text: - It's locked. -
scripts.translation: - 盒子被锁住了。 -

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hooray, finally some air, huh.
Let's go to Yuno. Huh?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
呼，终于透口气了。
我们去尤诺吧。嗯？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Here, come. Here it is, Come over here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这边，过来。在这里，过来这边。

scripts.text: Where are we going?
scripts.translation: 我们要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's what I'm trying to define adventurer. How can I set a destination when we have a VIP with us?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这正是我要定义的“冒险者”啊。带着VIP，我怎么好随便定目的地呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Where do we go? The VIP will decide. I will follow wherever you choose.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们要去哪里？由VIP决定。您选哪里，我就跟到哪里。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Don't you have to go the headquarters to investigate?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
难道你不该去总部调查吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I don't have to go to the headquarters to investigates~
Let's first look at the situation and the background information we have.
Then we'll look at the circumstances surrounding it.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我不需要去总部调查~
我们先看看目前的状况和已知的背景信息。
然后再看看周围的情况。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you know how to investigate, set yourself a concrete goal with a detailed plan? I know a thing or two~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你知道怎么调查吗？给自己定个具体的目标，再做个详细的计划？我懂一点点~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ahahaha! Courtesy, courtesy! Let's be polite to our VIP!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊哈哈！礼貌，礼貌！我们要对VIP有礼貌！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
How about we start with something a little less difficult, how about we start this investigation differently? How about we let the VIP choose.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不如我们从简单点的开始？换个方式开始调查？不如让VIP来选。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Well, what am I supposed to choose?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那我该选什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Pick on of the names on the list randomly. If I select one, you'd say I manipulated the results later otherwise.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
从名单上随机选一个名字。如果我选，你之后会说我操纵结果。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why are you looking at me like that? Don't you believe my heart?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你那样看着我干嘛？你不相信我的心吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Here, I choose that one. What are we going to do next?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
好了，我选这个。接下来我们要做什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let me see... ^0000CDPatrick Kaufmann^000000.
Well... that name is long, let's call him ^0000CDPat^000000 instead.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
让我看看... ^0000CD帕特·考夫曼^000000。
嗯...这个名字太长了，我们就叫他^0000CD帕特^000000吧。

scripts.text: Don't change his name!
scripts.translation: 别改他的名字！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh? Is it not economical? What's wrong, we'll save time using the name.
Also this will be a codename we can use among ourselves when refer to this scientist.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦？不划算吗？怎么了，用这个名字能省时间。
而且这是我们内部用来指代这位科学家的代号。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've been an agent for a long time, I know these things. There's an official way to handle these, but I can't tell you that information.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我当特工很久了，懂这些。处理这种事有正规流程，但我不能透露那些资讯。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now, can we all go together and find Pat? Lighthalzen is to the east. It is often said to be a ^0000CDslum^000000. Of course, our VIP knows all about this already, right?
You'd have read this in your paperwork.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在，我们一起去找帕特吧。里希塔乐镇在东边。那里常被称为^0000CD贫民窟^000000。当然，我们的VIP早就知道这些了，对吧？
你应该在文件里读到过。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What's your plan?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你的计划是什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Since he was a child, he would pick things up and fix them, and then resell. It's a talent that's been lost nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他从小就喜欢捡东西修好再卖掉。这是一种如今已经失传的天赋。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
At the age 21, he received a special award for low-income families. It caused a lot of envy from the people around him.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
21岁时，他获得了针对低收入家庭的特别奖项。这引起了周围人极大的嫉妒。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
He was moved to another Rekenber facility after 5 months, and then there is no record after that.
That's all the information about Pat.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
5个月后，他被转移到另一个雷肯贝设施，之后就没有记录了。
这就是关于帕特的所有资讯。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Our VIP has chosen a very suitable candidate for our investigation. I applaud you. It was a good idea.
It's not a common person on the list.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们的VIP选了一个非常合适的调查对象。我为你鼓掌。这是个好主意。
他不是名单上的普通人。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Are we only going to investigate him? What about the others?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们只调查他吗？其他人呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
How do you want to investigate so many people with only so few of us?
We focus on one person, don't you know how it works?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
就我们这么几个人，怎么调查那么多人？
我们集中火力在一个人身上，你不知道这样办事吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
After all, they all disappeared in a similar fashion. So once we figure out what happened to one of them, we'll know what happened to the rest too.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
毕竟，他们的失踪方式都很相似。所以一旦查清其中一人的遭遇，就能知道其他人的情况了。

scripts.text: What am I going to do here?
scripts.translation: 我要在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Good morning~ From now on VIP's, the journey of Pat from his work to Rekenber to the present is for us to figure out~ with Lazy and his team~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
早上好~ 从现在开始，VIP们，我们要一起理清帕特从工作到雷肯贝再到现在的轨迹~ 由我和我的团队~

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
So what? When you do your investigations, do you think it's a game?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
所以呢？你做调查的时候，觉得这是游戏吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do I seem like a joke to you VIP?
I'm quite serious, don't you believe me VIP?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
VIP，我看起来像在开玩笑吗？
我很认真，你不相信我吗，VIP？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We'll follow Pat's work schedule. We can follow his traces and understand a bit more about what happened as to why he's missing.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们会按照帕特的日程来追踪。顺着他的踪迹，我们能更了解他失踪的原因。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You've never taken a good look at the Lighthalzen village. I'm from a big city and I know a few places I can recommend to start with.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你从未仔细看过里希塔乐镇。我来自大城市，我知道几个可以开始调查的地方。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
When you say Lighthalzen is a village, what do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你说里希塔乐镇是个村庄，是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Guard, are you tired? Compared to Yuno, Lighthalzen is a small village.
Yuno is a really nice place. I often say this. Yuno is the city of Sages. Well, I would say it differently.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
卫兵，你累了吗？和尤诺相比，里希塔乐镇只是个小小的村庄。
尤诺是个非常棒的地方。我经常这么说。尤诺是贤者的城市。嗯，我会换个说法。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The jewel of Rune-Midgard, the heart of the country, is Yuno. Everyone should visit at least once.
If anyone would ask me about the future of Rune-Midgard, I'd bet my life it would be the brilliant city of Yuno.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
尤诺是米德加尔特之珠，国家的心脏。每个人都应该至少去一次。
如果有人问我米德加尔特未来的希望在哪里，我敢拿我的生命打赌，那一定是光辉灿烂的尤诺城。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Anyway, there's nothing as good as traveling around here and there.
It's also very good to deceive others. Why would suspect a tourist? Right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总之，到处走走看看是最好的。
这也非常适合欺骗别人。谁会怀疑一个游客呢？对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Should we really do that? Go to the headquarters and investigate?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们真的应该那样做吗？去总部进行调查？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
There are some things you can't learn from paperwork. Can a VIP explain what the yellow color is someone who doesn't know yellow?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
有些事情是从文件里学不到的。VIP，你能向一个不认识黄色的人解释什么是黄色吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Wouldn't it be quicker to just show the person yellow flowers and explain it?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
直接把黄色花朵拿给他看，然后解释，不是更快吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
There are many things I don't know outside my papers. That's partly why I came along with you.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
文件之外有很多我不知道的事情。这也是我跟着你来的原因之一。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's right. Do you feel bad? It's the truth though. Only mouth to mouth reveal true facts.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没错。你感到难过吗？虽然这是事实。只有口口相传才能揭示真相。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I understand. If we don't go over there, there will be only controversy with our reports.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我明白了。如果我们不去那里，我们的报告只会引起争议。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's the purpose of this tour. Now let's go, we don't have much time.
Let's head over there with a non-fair First Class seat, it will be more comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这就是这次旅行的目的。现在出发吧，我们时间不多了。
让我们坐一等座去那里，会舒服一些。

scripts.text: First Class? Last time we traveled...
scripts.translation: 一等座？上次我们旅行时...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey!! I'm on official duty now! I'm also going to take First Class.
Does the adventurer not have a First Class fake pass?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘿！！我现在是在执行公务！我也要坐一等座。
冒险者难道没有一等座的假通行证吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Nobody has the money to pay First Class except the VIP. He can just bring us along.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
除了VIP，没人有钱坐一等座。他可以直接带我们一起去。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Hmm!
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
哼！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Thank you! Courtesy, courtesy! Now, let's all go to <NAVI>[Lighthalzen]<INFO>lighthalzen,259,215,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
谢谢！礼尚往来，礼尚往来！现在，我们要一起去<NAVI>[里希塔乐镇]<INFO>lighthalzen,259,215,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now, let's all go to <NAVI>[Lighthalzen]<INFO>lighthalzen,259,215,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在，我们要一起去<NAVI>[里希塔乐镇]<INFO>lighthalzen,259,215,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Aren't you supposed to be working right now?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你不应该正在工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Shouldn't we listen to what Daisy have to say?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们不应该听听戴西要说什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Do you know where Daisy is trying to bring us? Can we trust you?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你知道戴西想带我们去哪里吗？我们可以信任你吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Here we are, Sector 01 - Section 95-146 in the Einbroch Mountains.
This is the new laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们到了，这里是艾音布罗克山脉的第01区 - 95-146号地块。
这就是新的实验室。

scripts.text: There's nothing here.
scripts.translation: 这里什么都没有。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I thought it was here. Lazy must be wondering ^0000FFwhat this means.^000000 I only saw the world from sitting at my desk. I believed my view was true.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我以为是这里。懒散一定在想^0000FF这是什么意思。^000000我只坐在办公桌前看世界。我以为我所看到的就是真实的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Everything I've heard and saw... I feel as if there was an invisible person manipulating everything. This is not a scenario I thought could be possible.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我所听到和看到的一切...我感觉好像有一个隐形的人在操纵着一切。这不是我认为可能发生的情景。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Even if everything looks fine on the surface, there are so many lies within. I've been deceived.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
即使表面看起来一切正常，里面却充满了谎言。我被欺骗了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you don't investigate with suspicious, you won't see any problems on the surface.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你不带着怀疑去调查，你就不会看到表面下的任何问题。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
But that's so... not trusting...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
但是那样做...就是缺乏信任...

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes... that's true.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是的...你说得对。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey, you're there already. How is it? What have you found out with your own two eyes?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘿，你们已经在那儿了。情况怎么样？你们亲眼看到了什么？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I realized that papers are easy tools to deceive someone who's only sitting at a desk and doing their own thing.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我意识到，对于只坐在办公桌前做着自己事情的人来说，纸张是很容易用来欺骗他们的工具。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
There is no lab here. There was nothing on our end either.
Absolutely nothing.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这里没有实验室。我们这边也没有任何东西。
绝对什么都没有。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If everything on that document is false, then we can't find any more information.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
如果那份文件上的一切都是假的，那么我们就无法找到更多的信息了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
What do we do now?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我们现在该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well. We have to keep looking for the location of this new laboratory. When we find it, we'll have to research it from the inside.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯。我们必须继续寻找这个新实验室的位置。当我们找到它时，我们必须从内部进行研究。

scripts.text: You don't have anything else Lazy?
scripts.translation: 你还有其他关于懒散的信息吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Dear adventurer, have you forgotten who's been helping you now? The Rebellion has been roaming these areas.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
亲爱的冒险者，你忘了是谁在帮助你吗？反叛者一直在这些地区活动。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The laboratory that I discovered a while, and the waste site. I'm sure it's only a matter of time before it's revealed. It must be nearby.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我之前发现的那个实验室，还有那个废物处理场。我相信迟早会暴露的。它一定就在附近。

scripts.text: How do you know?
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
It requires a large workforce and a lot of materials to build a research facility. Even after its construction, materials should still be constantly coming in.
Wouldn't it be too hard for such supplies to pass through the borders?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
建造一个研究设施需要大量的人力和材料。即使在建成后，材料也应该持续不断地运进来。
这样的物资通过边境难道不是太难了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
So the laboratory is probably still in Schwarzwald. The materials can't be transported in the open,
so we have to look for a secret location, I guess it's going to be in one of those locations.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
所以实验室很可能还在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德。材料不能公开运输，
所以我们必须寻找一个秘密地点，我想它应该就在这些地方之一。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you hear that? That's smart.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你听到了吗？真聪明。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
As of now, Rekenber will now ^0000FFdedicate itself to cooperate with the investigation.^000000 Please tell me everything you need. We'll support you anyway we can.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
目前，雷肯贝尔将^0000FF全力配合调查工作。^000000请告诉我们您需要的一切，我们会尽所能支持您。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Alright, I'm glad to hear it, and I will gladly accept your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
很好，很高兴听到这话，我很乐意接受你们的合作。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I would like to personally apologize to Daisy. I'm sorry I didn't believe you. Thank you for coming to us.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我想亲自向黛西道歉。抱歉我当时没有相信你。谢谢你来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Daisy, if you need anything, please come and visit me at anytime.
You'll always be welcome.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
黛西，如果你需要任何帮助，请随时来找我。
你随时都受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
In the future, please call me Lazy. Let's go with me for another adventurer one day. Come to Yuno every now and then.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
以后请叫我懒散。总有一天，让我们一起去当冒险者吧。偶尔也来尤诺看看。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
But that's for another day. Let's focus on the mission at hand.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
不过那是以后的事了。让我们先专注于手头的任务。

scripts.text: Should I investigate further?
scripts.translation: 我要继续调查吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why not? What more can you do here, Hmm. I'm a little hungry. My legs hurt too. I need to get back to work. I'll have to deal with the VIP as well.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
为什么不呢？你在这里还能做什么呢？嗯...我有点饿了。腿也疼。我得回去工作了。还得去应付那位VIP。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
As such, I'm going to report the investigation regarding Pat's journey.
Everyone, let's go back to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
因此，我要去汇报关于帕特旅程的调查结果。
大家，让我们回到<NAVI>[猫在子弹上]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>吧~

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Did you go to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> yet?
Let's hurry. There's still a lot to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你去过<NAVI>[猫在子弹上]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>了吗？
我们快走吧。还有很多事要做。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Let's go back to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>.
I think we should hurry.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
让我们回到<NAVI>[猫在子弹上]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>。
我觉得我们应该快点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let's go to <NAVI>[Cat on Bullet]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>.
I'm already hungry.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们去<NAVI>[猫在子弹上]<INFO>pub_cat,93,105,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。
我已经饿了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Hehe?...
I can't believe this area is disguised as an abandoned mine.
Such a clumsy tricks~ He~ Boring~
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
嘿嘿？...
真不敢相信这片区域被伪装成了一座废弃矿场。
这种拙劣的把戏~ 哼~ 真无聊~

scripts.text: Please talk.
scripts.translation: 请说话

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Shh!
Not so loud!!
If we get caught, we're done for!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
嘘！
小声点！！
如果我们被发现了，就完蛋了！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Oh... I thought you were a rebellion member too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
哦...我还以为你也是反叛者的一员呢。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Do you see the ^FF0000mine entrance^000000 blocked by wire mesh?
I think it's the entrance to their main base.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
你看到被铁丝网封住的^FF0000矿场入口^000000了吗？
我想那是他们主要基地的入口。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I tried to get in a while ago, but it was blocked by wire mesh. I could see suspicious movements from the outside.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我之前试着进去过，但被铁丝网挡住了。我从外面看到了一些可疑的动静。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
If you go in by force, you will get chased down by dogs. You should ^FF0000scout nearby^000000 and wait for more support.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
如果你强行闯入，会被狗追得满街跑。你应该^FF0000在附近侦察^000000，并等待更多支援。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I've never seen anyone go onside...
I don't really know what's going to happen, so why don't you go have a look around?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我从来没见过有人敢正面硬刚...
我不知道接下来会发生什么，所以你要不先去周围看看？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I've never seen anyone go onside...
I don't really know what's going to happen, so why don't you go have a look around?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我从来没见过有人敢正面硬刚...
我不知道接下来会发生什么，所以你要不先去周围看看？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Hmmm.
There are no signs of people around...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
嗯。
周围没有人的迹象...

scripts.text: I'm going inside.
scripts.translation: 我要进去了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
I'm not joking, it's dangerous.
You're just going in to look right?
Tell me again when you're ^FF0000ready to go inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
我没开玩笑，那里很危险。
你只是进去看看吗？
等你^FF0000准备好进去^000000的时候再告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Are you all set?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Open the gate.
scripts.translation: 打开大门。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 进去看看

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
It's dangerous to go alone.
Wouldn't it be nice to go in with a ^FF0000party^000000?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
独自进去很危险。
和^FF0000队伍^000000一起进去不是更好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
That's weird~
Wait a minute.
Maybe the ^FF0000party leader^000000 hasn't opened the gate yet?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
真奇怪~
等一下。
也许是^FF0000队伍首领^000000还没打开大门？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
That's weird~
Wait a minute.
I don't think the gate is open, right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
真奇怪~
等一下。
大门好像还没打开，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
What?!
Have you forgotten the road to Clana Nemieri?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
什么？！
你忘了去夜巡者转职考试地点的路了吗？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
What happened to you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
你发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
What?!
Dien's room?
It's on the second floor of Clana Nemieri.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
什么？！
迪恩的房间？
它在夜巡者转职考试地点的二楼。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Crew]
Huh...
It used to be great...
It was great...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者成员]
啊...
以前这里很棒...
真的很棒...

scripts.text:
- Nothing special here. -
- Let's go back to the Rebellion. -
scripts.translation:
- 这里没什么特别的。 -
- 让我们回到反叛者那里。 -

scripts.text:
- Nothing special here. -
- Let's look somewhere else. -
scripts.translation:
- 这里没什么特别的。 -
- 让我们去别处看看。 -

scripts.text:
[Republic Guard]
I've been contacted by Tes.
Don't worry I belong to the Secret Wing.
Aas and Est went to look around this area.
scripts.translation:
[共和国卫兵]
我收到了泰斯的消息。
别担心，我属于秘密部队。
阿斯和埃斯特去这一带侦察了。

scripts.text:
[Republic Guard]
Oh, there they are.
scripts.translation:
[共和国卫兵]
哦，他们在那边。

scripts.text:
[Est]
You've arrived at a good time.
I was just about to enter.
I've already used all the guys I brought along, so I needed some back up.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你来得正好。
我正准备进去。
我已经用完了带来的所有人手，所以需要一些增援。

scripts.text:
[Est]
It looks like there aren't enough to go inside...
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
看起来人手不够，无法进去...

scripts.text:
[Aas]
That was the plan. I told our soldiers to not harm anyone, and to keep a lookout. They won't fight carelessly.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
这就是计划。我告诉士兵们不要伤害任何人，只需保持警戒。他们不会鲁莽行事。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I need to know more about the current situation.
So first things first, this operation is meant to gather more information, and then we'll launch a full attack later...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我需要了解更多当前的情况。
所以首先，这次行动旨在收集更多信息，之后我们再发动全面进攻...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Hehe. Right. So me and Aas will go first.
The rest will be waiting, and they'll come in and when we give the signal.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
嘿嘿。没错。所以我和阿斯会先走。
其他人先待命，等我们发出信号后再进入。

scripts.text:
[Est]
It's more important to block out all the exits so that nobody escapes.
Everyone else, you know what to do right?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
更重要的是封锁所有出口，确保没人能逃跑。
其他人，你们知道该怎么做吧？

scripts.text:
[Est]
I'll go using another route, I'll leave it up to Aas and the adventurer.
Let's meet inside.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我会走另一条路线，剩下的就交给阿斯和冒险者了。
我们在里面汇合。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes I understand.
Well then, I'll tell Oscar to open the door. We have to do this!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我明白了。
那么，我会让奥斯卡开门。我们必须这么做！

scripts.text:
[Republic Guard]
The entrance is secured by Oscar who is standing up ahead the front gate.
Me and the Rebellions will stay outside. Aas will be inside.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[共和国卫兵]
入口由站在前门上方的奥斯卡把守。
我和反叛者会留在外面，阿斯会在里面。
祝好运！

scripts.text:
[Aas]
We have to open the main gate.
Let's open the door with Oscar.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我们必须打开正门。
让我们和奥斯卡一起开门吧。

scripts.text:
[Oscar]
The entrance for the lab has double locks.
It's closed from the inside.
It will be difficult to get it.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
实验室的入口有双重锁。
它是从里面锁上的。
很难打开。

scripts.text:
[Oscar]
I'm not too sure about the locks on the inside, so I don't know yet.
Let's secure 'Regenschirm' and find out.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
我不太确定里面的锁是什么情况，所以还不知道。
让我们先控制雷根修芦，然后再看情况。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text:
^4D4DFFThis place is a memorial dungeon.
Please form a party and try again.^000000
To create a party with the following command ^4D4DFF'/organize PARTY NAME'.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF这里是记忆地下城。
请组建队伍后再次尝试。^000000
使用指令 ^4D4DFF'/organize 队伍名称' 来创建队伍。^000000

scripts.text: Create '{0}'
Enter '{0}'

[Oscar]
The route hasn't been secured yet. Why don't you ask your party leader to prepare the route?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
路线尚未被控制。为什么不让你的队伍首领准备一下路线呢？

scripts.text:
[Oscar]
If you're ready, please enter.
The locks on the inside will be handled by Aas.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
如果你准备好了，请进入。
里面的锁会由阿斯处理。

scripts.text:
[Oscar]
They already secured the route.
Let's quietly move inside.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
他们已经控制了路线。
让我们悄悄进入吧。

scripts.text:
[Oscar]
There was a movement detected on the route that we've secured.
Let's wait a bit.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
在我们控制的路线上检测到了动静。
让我们稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Oscar]
You have a message from Tes back at the Cat on Bullet.
Please return back soon.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯卡]
你在子弹岛猫旅馆收到了泰斯的消息。
请尽快返回。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
雷根修芦的道路宽阔而闪亮~ 大家都知道修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Please gather around~ Let's check the number of people! Kaya Tos! Kaya Tos?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
请集合~ 让我们清点一下人数！卡雅托斯！卡雅托斯？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, there you are! Gather around!
There we're all together now!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，你来了！大家集合一下！
现在我们都到齐了！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
The investigation is looking good, but could you stop this ridiculous behavior.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
调查进展顺利，但你能不能别做这种荒唐的举动。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I thought the VIP said there were only two conditions? Besides, everyone has already heard me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我记得贵宾说只有两个条件？而且，大家已经都听到我说话了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We're now officially travelers from the Schwarzwald Republic. It would be hard to look around while hiding everywhere we went to anyway.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们现在正式成为修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的旅人了。反正到处躲藏的话，也很难四处查看。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Traveling here is truly awesome~ I can feel this excitement. How do you think historians will write this day?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在这里旅行真是太棒了~ 我能感受到这份兴奋。你觉得历史学家会如何记载这一天呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Kaya, relax. Leave your problems behind and just pretend you're on a holiday. You'll get a clearer perspective.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
卡雅，放松一下。把烦恼抛在脑后，就当是在度假吧。这样你会看得更清楚。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
First, try to look around on this trip. See how you feel about it.
What should you do if you feel something? You should act upon it.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
首先，试着在这趟旅途中四处看看。感受一下你的心情。
如果你感觉到了什么，就应该付诸行动。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
A small report~ It's not just to admire and do nothing, right?
Surely... there's a reason why you're traveling with us.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
一份小报告~ 总不能只是欣赏风景而无所事事，对吧？
毕竟...你跟我们一起旅行，肯定是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
By the way, did the VIP feel uncomfortable with non-fair use of the First Class? The start is uncomfortable, but the rest of the journey will be smooth.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
顺便问一下，贵宾对头等舱的不公平使用感到不适吗？刚开始可能有点不舒服，但接下来的旅程会很顺畅。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
When I went by train, that felt like more First Class. Was it a good experience?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我坐火车的时候，感觉那才更像头等舱。体验如何？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The VIP is getting familiar with us, it will give him some inspiration. Ahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
贵宾正在熟悉我们，这会给他一些灵感。啊哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
We should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们得快点。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The VIP wants to be economical. I understand. Let me explain our plan as economically as possible.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
贵宾想节省开支。我理解。让我尽可能简洁地解释一下我们的计划。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Here at Lighthalzen, the downtown and the slums coexist with one another. Both sides has structures that make it hard to easily cross the railway from the side to the other.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
在里希塔乐镇，市中心和贫民区共存。两边都有建筑结构，使得很难从侧面轻松穿越铁路。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Normally, we'd all be issued a pass to go around freely, but we don't have time for now this is the best I've managed to prepare.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
通常，我们都会发放通行证以便自由通行，但现在没时间了，这是我目前能准备到的最好方案。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What is that?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, don't worry it's kind of a free pass for our agents. Of course, you don't need to know more.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，别担心，这算是给我们特工的一种免费通行证。当然，你不需要知道更多。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now we should go to the <NAVI>[slums]<INFO>lighthalzen,336,266,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在我们应该去<NAVI>[贫民区]<INFO>lighthalzen,336,266,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've found where to go next. Let's go over to the<NAVI>[slums]<INFO>lighthalzen,336,266,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> next.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我找到下一个目的地了。让我们去<NAVI>[贫民区]<INFO>lighthalzen,336,266,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let's go to the headquarters. The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
让我们去总部吧。雷根修芦的道路宽阔而闪亮~ 大家都知道修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is Pat's home. This is where Pat first got into contact with Rekenber and met a staff member.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这里是帕特的家。帕特就是在这里第一次接触雷根修芦，并结识了一位职员。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Pat probably worked hard to get a chance out of poverty and live a better life. He wanted to start anew.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
帕特大概很努力地想要摆脱贫困，过上更好的生活。他想重新开始。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Heyo! There you are. Mom, Dad, how are you?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘿！你们在这儿。妈妈，爸爸，你们好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Who...?

[Father]
Oh, he's the one who's been searching for Patrick a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[神父]
哦，他之前一直在寻找帕特里克。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Aah, that's you! Did you meet... with Pat?
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
啊，是你啊！你见到...帕特了吗？

scripts.text:
[Father]
Why'd you think they lose someone who was doing well in the Enterprise?
scripts.translation:
[神父]
你觉得一个在企业发展得不错的人为什么会失踪？

scripts.text:
[Mother]
No, something is definitely not right! He's not the type of person that would ^0000FFjust stop contacting us.^000000
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
不，肯定有什么不对劲！他绝不是那种会^0000FF突然停止联系我们的人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Father]
If you're not too busy, perhaps you could keep looking! I'm doing everything to send the paychecks all the way!
scripts.translation:
[神父]
如果你不忙的话，也许可以继续找找看！我正在尽全力把工资寄回来！

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Eh? Of course that's important!
It's how we're able to provide for Pat. But it's strange we haven't heard back from him yet.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
诶？那当然很重要！
那是我们养活帕特的来源。但奇怪的是，我们还没收到他的消息。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Heeey~ Mom, don't fight with Dad.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘿~ 妈妈，别和爸爸吵架。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I came here with a very high ^0000FFimportant^000000 member of your son's company. What did I tell you the other day? He's came to see the welfare of the families who have hired special talent.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我是和你儿子公司里一位非常^0000FF重要^000000的成员一起来的。我之前告诉过你什么？他是来探望那些雇佣了特殊人才的家庭的。

scripts.text:
[Father]
Hello~ Is this him?
scripts.translation:
[神父]
你好~ 是他吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes, that's him. You can ask him questions as much as you'd like. He came here for this sole reason.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
是的，就是他。你可以随便问他问题。他来这里的唯一目的就是这个。

scripts.text:
[Father]
Hello~ I don't really know where to begin... Thank you for taking in my son, my family isn't worried having enough food to survive anymore. Thank you, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[神父]
你好~ 我都不知道该从哪里说起... 谢谢你们收留我的儿子，我的家人不再为生计发愁了。谢谢，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Father]
You may think my son isn't worthy but he's very good at fixing things.
scripts.translation:
[神父]
你可能觉得我的儿子不够优秀，但他很擅长修理东西。

scripts.text:
[Father]
Thanks to the employment, I have a job and can feed my family now. I take pride in it.
scripts.translation:
[神父]
多亏了这份工作，我有了一份职业，能养活家人了。我为此感到自豪。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
But, we don't even know if he's alive or not.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
但是，我们甚至不知道他还活着没有。

scripts.text:
[Father]
I wonder whether or not I should go to the company and ask for him directly, I'm busy at work and I can't contact him.
scripts.translation:
[神父]
我在想是否应该去公司直接找他，但我工作很忙，无法联系上他。

scripts.text:
[Father]
I don't want to get in trouble with the company, I told my son to follow orders and not complain.
scripts.translation:
[神父]
我不想和公司发生冲突，我告诉儿子要服从命令，不要抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Father]
If there's a problem on how things are going, please let us know. From his childhood, he's always been listening closely and he can fix anything.
scripts.translation:
[神父]
如果有什么不对劲的地方，请告诉我们。他从小就善于倾听，而且什么都能修好。

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Please honey! You're not asking the important questions. Is there any regulation prohibiting my son from contacting us? I haven't contacted since the day my child was hired, I can't even contact him myself...
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
亲爱的！你问的不是重点。难道没有规定禁止我儿子联系我们吗？自从他被录用那天起，我就没联系过他，我甚至无法联系上他...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
There are no regulations to restrict personal contact. We also pay holidays based on the government's recommendation... Your son says he's on vacation.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
没有规定限制私人联系。我们也按照政府建议支付假期...您儿子说他正在休假。

scripts.text:
[Father]
So you mean to say Patrick wouldn't even come visit us?
scripts.translation:
[神父]
所以你的意思是，帕特连来看望我们都不会来？

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Maybe he doesn't like us anymore... ^0000FFOn my first vacation^000000, I just came back to my family and talked to them.
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
也许他不再喜欢我们了... ^0000FF在我第一次休假时^000000，我只是回家和家人聊了聊天。

scripts.text:
[Father]
Oh, I can do that when I'm at work!
What the hell are you doing with the Enterprise people! How come it's gone this far!
scripts.translation:
[神父]
哦，我在工作时也能做到！
你们和“企业”的人到底在搞什么鬼！事情怎么会发展到这一步！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Gosh! Mom, Dad! Thank you! So you can't even contact him, aren't you curious what's happening with him? I'm sure you are.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
天哪！妈妈，爸爸！谢谢你们！既然你们连联系都联系不上，难道不想知道他发生了什么吗？我相信你们一定很好奇。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We'll meet with your son, keep going with our investigation and then contact you. You can both trust me and wait. You believe me right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们会去见您儿子，继续调查，然后联系你们。你们可以信任我并等待。相信我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother]
Oh my~ I can't believe it. Thank you so much. I'm afraid it will be hard for us to contact you...
scripts.translation:
[母亲]
哎呀~ 真不敢相信。太感谢了。我担心我们会很难联系到您...

scripts.text:
[Father]
Aaah~ how to contact you! No matter what! Please contact us again, even if we're busy!
scripts.translation:
[神父]
啊~ 怎么联系您！无论如何！请再联系我们，即使我们很忙！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Okay. Then we'll get going!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好的。那我们要出发了！

scripts.text:
[Father]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[神父]
保重！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you hear all of that? As stated in the documents, they never even got a call after he joined the Enterprise. Well, I don't like seeing them like that, but I have to keep my first tourist promise.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你都听到了吧？正如文件所述，他加入“企业”后甚至没接到过电话。嗯，我不喜欢看到他们这样，但我必须遵守对第一位游客的承诺。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'm sure the employees don't come visit their home during their vacations. Isn't it a ^0000FFprivacy matter^000000 that is none of our business?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我确信员工在休假时不会回家探亲。这不是^0000FF隐私问题^000000吗？这与我们无关，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And you think it's like that for everyone in these documents? No way? Pat is a family person, do you really think he wouldn't come back home when he's on vacation because of personal problems? Do you really believe that?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你觉得这些文件里的每个人都是这样吗？不可能吧？帕特是个重视家庭的人，你真的认为他休假时会因为个人问题而不回家吗？你真的相信吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
How about you, guard?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
那你呢，卫兵？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Are you asking me?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你在问我？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes, you. Your guard doesn't look like someone who enjoys sitting in a hotel, so how about you? Don't you meet with the people you know during your vacations?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
是的，就是你。你的卫兵看起来不像那种喜欢坐在酒店里的人，那你呢？你休假时会不见见认识的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes, I often meet with my family during my vacations, sometimes even my friends.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是的，我休假时经常和家人见面，有时也会和朋友见面。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
See? I knew it. Who wouldn't do that? Okay sure. Maybe one guy out of ten.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
看吧？我就知道。谁不会这么做呢？好吧，也许十个人里有一个例外。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
The company doesn't investigate private matters. It's private for a reason. Ask yourself if you'd want someone else to look into your private matters.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
公司不会调查私人事务。既然是私事，自然有其理由。问问你自己，你希望别人去调查你的私事吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Aah~ Do you want to meet with them for a few more minutes~ Will the VIP come here again?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊~ 你想再和他们聊几分钟吗~ VIP还会再来这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I think I heard as much as I need to here. We'll find the rest of the information in the headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我觉得我在这里已经听到足够多的信息了。剩下的资料我们去总部找。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The people who made these documents don't know anything about Pat. It's not just one or two persons on this list. Should you really listen to one person?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
制作这些文件的人对帕特一无所知。名单上可不止一两个人。你真的只听信一个人的话吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Aren't you tired of walking this path narrow, steep path?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
走这条又窄又陡的路，你不累吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Are you tired already? There are people like this everyday. As your people suffer, more people suffer, so much that you can't even recognize pain.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你已经累了吗？每天都有这样的人。随着受苦的人越来越多，痛苦多到你甚至无法辨认什么是痛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Are you giving me orders?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你在给我下命令吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hello~ I'm just a tourist guide, how can I give you orders. The judgment is done by the VIP's intellect, reasoning and conscience~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你好~ 我只是一个导游，怎么能给你下命令呢。判断是由VIP的智慧、理性和良知做出的~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Alright! We're going to follow up with Pat, so the tour's next location will be at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好的！我们要去跟进帕特的情况，所以导游的下一站是<NAVI>[总部]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Alright! We're going to follow up with Pat, so the tour's next place will be at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好的！我们要去跟进帕特的情况，所以导游的下一站是<NAVI>[总部]<INFO>lighthalzen,107,165,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
雷根修芦的道路宽阔而闪亮~ 大家都知道修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer! You're here! Who else would it be?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者！你来了！除了你还能是谁呢？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You're finally here. Am I too fast for you? Or do you think perhaps it's because the VIP's shoes are not suited for long distances?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你终于来了。是我走得太快了吗？还是你觉得VIP的长靴不适合长途跋涉？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We're finally here at Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们终于到达雷肯贝尔了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
When Pat stood in front of the building, he was probably relieved.
The job in the slums wasn't that much different than the one at Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当帕特站在那栋建筑前时，他可能松了一口气。
贫民窟的工作和雷肯贝尔的工作并没有太大区别。

scripts.text:
[Protester]
Rekenber, ^0000FFexplain!^000000
scripts.translation:
[抗议者]
雷肯贝尔，^0000FF解释一下！^000000

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Explanation?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
解释？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ah! Well done. I wanted to introduce her to you. She's the fiance of ^0000FFanother missing person^000000 on the list.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊！做得好。我想把你介绍给她。她是名单上^0000FF另一位失踪者^000000的未婚妻。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Her fiance was hired by the Rekenber, and then she wasn't able to contact him anymore. Of course, she tried to contact the company and asked what was going on, but what did they tell her?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
她的未婚妻被雷肯贝尔雇佣，之后她就再也联系不上他了。当然，她试图联系公司询问情况，但他们怎么回答她的？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hey Eva! Hello! Come over here, over here!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嘿，伊娃！你好！过来这边，这边！

scripts.text:
[Protester]
Daisy? Hi. Do you have more information on what happened?
scripts.translation:
[抗议者]
黛西？你好。关于发生的事，你有更多的信息吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, that? I don't know yet, but I came here with the Vice President to find out.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，那个啊？我还不清楚，但我跟副总裁一起来这里就是为了查明真相的。

scripts.text:
[Protester]
The Vice... President? This person?
scripts.translation:
[抗议者]
副...总裁？是指这个人吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah, that's right. You have something to tell him? Go ahead!
This will be good, I don't regret getting out of bed today!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
没错，就是他。你有什么话想对他说的吗？尽管说吧！
这下值了，我今天起床真是起对了！

scripts.text:
[Eva]
What happened to Marcus? Give me my Marcus back! It's been 2 years since I haven't heard from Marcus!
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
马库斯到底怎么了？把我的马库斯还给我！已经两年没收到马库斯的消息了！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You're looking for Marcus? Mar...cus... Holzman. He's from the East of Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你在找马库斯？马...库斯...霍兹曼。他来自里希塔乐镇东部...

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh, what a coincidence. He's also from the Lighthalzen slums!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哦，真巧。他也是里希塔乐镇贫民窟的人！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Maybe he doesn't want to contact you anymore?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
也许他不想再联系你了？

scripts.text:
[Eva]
Marcus would never do that to me! My Marcus... Marcus...
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
马库斯绝不会那样对我！我的马库斯...马库斯...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
No matter what the truth is, I don't know a third person with the same issue as yours.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
不管真相如何，我不认识第三个遇到同样问题的人。

scripts.text:
[Eva]
Even if Marcus's thoughts about me had changed, he's not the only one!
Most of the people from the slums that are hired by the Rekenber ^0000FFcannot be reached anymore.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
即使马库斯对我的想法变了，他也不是唯一一个！
大多数被雷肯贝尔雇佣的贫民窟居民^0000FF都再也联系不上了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Eva]
Do you really think everyone would change their minds like that? To their family? Their friends? Even lovers? It's a bigger issue!
What the hell did Rekenber do with their employees?!
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
你真的认为每个人都会那样改变心意吗？对家人？对朋友？甚至对爱人？这问题更严重！
雷肯贝尔到底对他们的员工做了什么？！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I would like to know more details about this. Let's go back. If we make a disturbance here, they'll call the police.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我想了解更多细节。我们回去吧。如果在这里引起骚动，他们会叫警察的。

scripts.text:
[Eva]
What? Do you want to throw me out?
Am I a problem to you? Do you think I'll give up easily? I will keep coming until I find Marcus!
scripts.translation:
[伊娃]
什么？你想赶我走？
我是你的麻烦吗？你以为我会轻易放弃吗？我会一直来，直到找到马库斯为止！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
She said he saw the VIP...
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
她说她看到了VIP...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What are you trying to say?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你想说什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You're a VIP. You're so beautiful, I'm very impressed. Tsk. Tsk. Tsk.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你是VIP。你真漂亮，我很佩服。啧。啧。啧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Listen carefully. As I said before, joining Rekenber is the envy of most people in the slums. If you can't imagine how excited it is for them, then maybe you can't think.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
仔细听。正如我之前所说，加入雷肯贝尔是贫民窟大多数人的羡慕对象。如果你无法想象他们有多兴奋，那你可能缺乏思考能力。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
For such people, Rekenber has been giving out special gifts as part of social welfare, don't you know about it. Rekenber is tricking people.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
对于这些人，雷肯贝尔一直发放特殊福利作为社会福利，你不知道吗？雷肯贝尔在欺骗人们。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Are you disrespecting the company's welfare business? I get the same treatment as those who have been specially selected.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你是在贬低公司的福利业务吗？我得到的待遇和那些被特别选中的人是一样的。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's not what I'm saying VIP. The secretary here knows too. Do you really not know? Are you pretending?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我说的不是这个，VIP。这里的秘书也知道。你真的不知道吗？你是在装傻吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Have you seen Rekenber's criteria for their special offer?
People who have healthy body and no families. Among them, why would they only pick the poorest?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你看过雷肯贝尔特殊福利的入选标准吗？
身体健康且没有家庭的人。在这些人中，为什么他们只挑选最贫穷的人？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
What do you think this means? Why only people with good health~ or no money~ then they disappear only to get paychecks to their house~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你觉得这意味着什么？为什么只选身体健康~或者没钱~的人，然后他们就消失了，只留下寄到家里的工资单~

scripts.text:
[Aas]
But there's a single missing person around me.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
但我身边有一个失踪的人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Woah, is that really surprising?
You're a guard? Your guard is from the borders of Rune-Midgard, right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哇哦，这真的令人惊讶吗？
你是卫兵？你的卫兵来自鲁恩米德加尔特边境，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
How did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你怎么知道的？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's easy to recognize a person from their personality and their tone of voice. It's easy for anyone to know, but I can see it just by looking at your face.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
从一个人的性格和语气就能很容易地认出他们。这对任何人来说都不难，但我只要看你的脸就能看出来。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Speaking of personalities, I'm like a guard myself and our spirits can't be broken. You can't break me like a wheel, I'll fight back.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
说到性格，我自己就像个卫兵，我们的意志是无法被击垮的。你无法像碾碎轮子一样碾碎我，我会反击。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I would rather use force than make compromises.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我宁愿使用武力，也不愿做出妥协。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hah! That's it, that's the spirit. The type that day to day! You would have never allowed your friends to have gone missing just like that. Your personality is what saved our guard, for now anyway.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哈哈！就是这样，这就是精神。那种日复一日的精神！你绝不会允许你的朋友就这样失踪。你的性格救了我们的卫兵，至少暂时是这样。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Anyway do you have a special unit in your guard? I know the answer already.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
总之，你的卫兵中有特殊部队吗？我已经知道答案了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes... we do.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是的...我们有。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I knew it. The VIP says you all get the same treatment. But he won't give security to the people of the slums.
The people in your team are the kind of people who don't go missing.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我就知道。VIP说你们得到的待遇是一样的。但他不会给贫民窟的人提供安全保障。
你团队中的人是不会失踪的那种人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Simply because it's more troublesome to make a guard disappear. It makes more noises.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
仅仅是因为让卫兵失踪更麻烦。他们会制造更多的噪音。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
With the money and the welfare paychecks, isn't it easier to just make someone disappear from a vulnerable family and then make their voices unheard?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
有了钱和福利工资单，让一个脆弱家庭中的某人消失，然后让他们无声无息，不是更容易吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Do you even know what you're insinuating now? It's all speculations!
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你知道你在暗示什么吗？这全是猜测！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you really know what I'm thinking?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你真的知道我在想什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Come in and check it out yourself!
Let's see why they never made contact. I don't know what they did during their vacations, but we can see where they are now.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
进来自己看看吧！
让我们看看他们为什么从未联系过。我不知道他们在休假期间做了什么，但我们可以看到他们现在在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hah, this guy, he's still all about privacy. Are statistics and odds not part of the economy? Why do all of these people go and never contact their house again?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哈哈，这家伙，他还是那么注重隐私。统计和概率不是经济的一部分吗？为什么这些人一去不复返，再也不联系家里？

scripts.text: Why are they giving their salaries?
scripts.translation: 为什么他们还在发工资？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Our adventurer asked a good question. They are almost all from the slums. In Rekenber, they offer you accommodations, with meals and lodging, you hardly have to spend any money at all.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们的冒险者问了一个好问题。他们几乎都来自贫民窟。在雷肯贝尔，他们提供住宿，包括食宿，你几乎不需要花任何钱。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If the adventurer is from a poor family, and you have to support it, would you spare money for your meals?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果冒险者出身贫寒，又需要供养家人，你还会把钱花在吃饭上吗？

scripts.text: I would send everything.
scripts.translation: 我会把一切都寄回去。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
These accommodations for the low-income classes is Rekenber's contribution to society. We do our best!
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
这些针对低收入阶层的住宿是雷肯贝尔对社会的贡献。我们尽力了！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ahah! Was I not polite enough? Our VIP is getting angry~ But the adventurer and I have gone to many places before, we know these things.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊哈哈！是我不够礼貌吗？我们的贵宾要生气了~ 不过冒险者和我之前去过很多地方，我们懂这些。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
It's an illegal laboratory. You know what an illegal laboratory is?
It would be used for illegal experiments with human life? Used like a lab rats?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这是个非法实验室。你知道非法实验室是做什么的吗？
用来进行非法的人体实验？像小白鼠一样被使用？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Aren't you imagining too much now.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你想象力未免太丰富了吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Our guard here and the VIP are not imaginative? I know you don't see to look at what's in front of you, but look at the reality of the situation here.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们这里的卫兵和贵宾难道不富有想象力吗？我知道你不想看眼前的东西，但看看这里的现实情况吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you know what your colleagues ate and what they were doing before the day was over?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你知道你的同事们在一天结束前吃了什么，做了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did the VIP know about the disappearance of his employees until I pushed to investigate about it?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
直到我坚持调查，贵宾才知道他的员工失踪了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I still cannot conclude that they're missing.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我仍然不能断定他们失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Alright, I see. Let's call it a problem, not a missing person. Do you feel better then? If it makes it easier for you, I'll call it that. Do you even want to solve this problem in a positive light?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
好吧，我明白了。让我们称之为“问题”，而不是“失踪人口”。这样你感觉好点了吗？如果这样让你更容易接受，我就这么叫。你真的想以积极的态度解决这个问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Of course.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
当然。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Perfect, I had hoped you'd say that. I'm glad to see you're not angry anymore. So open your mind~ don't get angry~ breath slowly~ exhale~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
完美，我希望你能这么说。很高兴看到你不再生气了。所以打开你的心~ 别生气~ 慢慢呼吸~ 呼气~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
If you're right, then let's check it out at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
如果你是对的，那我们就去<NAVI>[总部]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Come on, get inside the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
来吧，进入<NAVI>[总部]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
雷根修芦的道路宽阔而闪亮~ 大家都知道修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国~

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Hello, how may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
您好，有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We've finally enter the Rekenber's headquarters. I wonder if Pat was relieved when he first passed through this door. Where did he go next?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们终于进入了雷肯贝尔的总部。我想知道帕特第一次穿过这扇门时是否松了一口气。他接下来去了哪里？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Do all employees go through OT?
I thought they would assign them to their department directly.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
所有员工都要经过OT吗？
我以为他们会直接分配到各自的部门。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Ah yes, you're right. For the special talented people, they must go through OT first and then they are assigned to their own respective department.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
啊，是的，你说得对。对于有特殊才能的人，他们必须先经过OT，然后才会被分配到各自的部门。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Why is that?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
It's a system based on their ^0000FFplace of origin^000000. There are many people who are not familiar with the corporate culture. After many trials and errors, the new employees are now required to go through OT.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
这是基于他们的^0000FF出身地^000000制定的制度。很多人对公司的文化并不熟悉。经过多次尝试和错误后，现在新员工都必须参加OT。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let's go the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> where Pat started his life at Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
让我们去<NAVI>[会议室]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，那里是帕特在雷肯贝尔开始职业生涯的地方。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I think the others went to the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, where the meetings are held. Shouldn't you be going?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
我想其他人去了<NAVI>[会议室]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>，那里是开会的场所。你不应该也去吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Do you need an assistance with something?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
您需要什么帮助吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let's ask this guy for information.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
让我们问问这个人一些信息。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you know Kaufmann? Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你认识考夫曼吗？帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The Vice President is looking for Kaufmann.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
副总裁正在寻找考夫曼。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I see, what is the purpose. And... who are you again?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
我明白了，目的是什么。还有...你又是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Are you the secretary of the Vice President?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你是副总裁的秘书吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
What are you talking about? Did your secretary get hit on the head? You sound like an outsider?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你在说什么？你的秘书被撞到头了吗？你听起来像个外人？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'm looking for Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我在找帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
You, who are you... ? I've seen that face before... are you...?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你，你是谁...？我好像见过这张脸...你是...？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
He is your Vice President.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他是你的副总裁。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Aaah! Yes, right, right!!! ...Vice President? Oh, hello!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
啊！是的，没错，没错！！！...副总裁？哦，您好！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Do you know anything about Patrick Kaufmann?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你知道帕特里克·考夫曼的情况吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Patrick Kaufmann... I know him. He's a good friend of mine. He has rough hands but his work is fast and accurate.
I tried to keep him around longer, but they took him to the lab.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
帕特里克·考夫曼...我认识他。他是我的好朋友。他的手很粗糙，但工作又快又准。
我想让他留得更久一点，但他们把他调到了实验室。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
The laboratory? Was it Regenschirm?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
实验室？是雷根修芦吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Yes, there. The newcomers must be in the company for ^0000FFat least a whole year^000000 before they can be sent to another department or a new workplace, unless they are given a ^0000FFspecial request.^000000
scripts.translation:
[职员]
是的，就是那里。新员工必须在公司工作^0000FF至少一年^000000，才能被调到其他部门或新的工作地点，除非他们收到^0000FF特别申请。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff]
But why would I send newcomers in the first place? I ignored the requests even though it came from above. But even so, some of the newcomers here were sent elsewhere anyway.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
但我为什么要调走新员工呢？即使上面有要求，我也忽略了。但即便如此，这里的一些新员工还是被调走了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Well you see... I need more people for repairs. There's always something broken, so I always need more manpower. But recently,
There's been ^0000FFa  lot more workforce requested.^000000
scripts.translation:
[职员]
是这样的...我需要更多人手来进行修复。总是有东西坏掉，所以我总是需要更多人力。但最近，
^0000FF请求的人力多得多。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you know why so many people were drafted?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你知道为什么这么多人被抽调吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I don't know for sure. Many people in our department get injured while working, and our newcomers are all very strong.
They only take those who are ^0000FFvery good at their job.^000000
scripts.translation:
[职员]
我不太确定。我们部门的很多人工作时都会受伤，而我们的新员工都非常强壮。
他们只带走那些^0000FF工作非常出色的人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff]
But if you are pressured from above, you have to abide and give them the workforce, right?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
但如果上面施压，你就必须服从并交出人力，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Which laboratory were they sent to?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
他们被送到了哪个实验室？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
The annex one. Oh, do you want to go? I haven't been there in a while, it's quite hard to get inside. If you don't mind, could you send people back here?
Anyway, please be careful, it is a dangerous place.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
一号附属楼。哦，你想去吗？我很久没去那里了，进去挺难的。如果你不介意，能把人送回来吗？
总之，请小心，那里很危险。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ooh.. You cannot be transferred at least until a whole year, unless you are given ^0000FFan unusual request.^000000
But Pat didn't get neither one of these reasons. Is it really a laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
噢...除非收到^0000FF特别申请^000000，否则至少一年内不能调岗。
但帕特既不符合这两种情况。那里真的是实验室吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did you know this VIP? was there anything about this in your documents? Why did the lab only take healthy and you people?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你认识这位VIP吗？你的文件里有相关记录吗？为什么实验室只带走健康的人？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I need to know why they broke the contract rules.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我需要知道他们为什么违反契约规定。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I was in charge of Regenschirm, but I've never seen Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我负责雷根修芦，但我从未见过帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yeah? You're getting curious too now, aren't you! Is that right?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
是吗？你现在也好奇起来了，对吧！是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I will guide you, follow me. Let's go to <NAVI>[Regenschirm]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我会指引你，跟我来。我们去<NAVI>[雷根修芦]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
They are waiting for you at the <NAVI>[laboratory]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, shouldn't you go as well?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
他们在<NAVI>[实验室]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>等你，你不也该去吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
There doesn't seem to be any room left.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
看起来已经没有空位了。

scripts.text:
[Secretary]
Hey, where are you going!
scripts.translation:
[秘书]
嘿，你们要去哪里！

scripts.text: Are you talking to us?
scripts.translation: 你在跟我们说话吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Adventurer, let's go quickly? Let's go together.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
冒险者，我们快走吧？一起走。

scripts.text:
[Secretary]
You came all the way to the office, what's going in? You left me alone in here and then just disappeared.
Why are you sneaking in?
scripts.translation:
[秘书]
你们大老远跑到办公室来，想干什么？把我一个人留在这里然后就这样消失了。
为什么要偷偷溜进来？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you know who's the gentlemen next to me?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你知道我旁边这位绅士是谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Yes, he is my secretary.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
是的，他是我的秘书。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Ah! Nice to meet you. My name is Daisy. I'm an old friend of the Vice President.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
啊！幸会。我叫黛西。我是副总裁的老朋友。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Hello there. I'm called Gray Earl.
I'm usually not in these places, we should continue this meeting in the Vice President's office.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
你好。我是格雷伯爵。
我通常不会出现在这种地方，我们最好去副总裁的办公室继续谈。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You don't have to. Here will be just fine. What are you doing in this place anyway? Were you waiting for someone?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
不用了。在这里就好。你在这里做什么？是在等什么人吗？

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Yes, I noticed something odd about the Vice President's absence, so I went out to see what was going on.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
是的，我注意到副总裁缺席有些不对劲，所以出去看看发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If you keep waiting outside like that, don't you think it looks even more suspicious?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
如果你一直像那样在外面等，难道不觉得更可疑吗？

scripts.text:
[Gray]
So you were hiding on purpose. Can you tell what this was all about?
Why all the secrecy?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
所以你是故意躲起来的。你能告诉我这一切是怎么回事吗？
为什么要这么保密？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
That was our plan. I'm cooperating with these people.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那是我们的计划。我正在和这些人合作。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Cooperating.. with them..?!
I didn't think we'd be friends with these people again.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
和...他们合作？！
我没想过我们会再和这些人成为朋友。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why? Can't we be friends? You! You'll have to explain yourself!
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
为什么？我们不能做朋友吗？你！你得解释清楚！

scripts.text:
[Gray]
You don't seem that old.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
你看起来并不老啊。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You don't need to know more about this. The less you know, the better. When we finish the investigation, we'll let you know.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你不需要知道更多。知道得越少越好。等我们调查结束，会通知你的。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
是的，先生。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
So, do you know who's in charge of moving the workforce from one department to another? Is it someone you trust?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那么，你知道谁负责在不同部门之间调动员工吗？是你信任的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Do you want the employee transfer logs? They are kept in the document storage room.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
你想要员工调动记录吗？它们保存在文件仓库里。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
If you want to uncover secrets, it would wiser to straight to the document storage room and search for the documents yourself than going through the Human Resource department.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
如果你想揭露秘密，直接去文件仓库自己查找文件，比通过人力资源部更明智。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Let me tell you where you can find these trustworthy documents.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
让我告诉你可以在哪里找到这些可靠的文件。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I know already.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我已经知道了。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Alright, then please be careful.
There are many eyes around here. You know what I mean, right?
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
好吧，那请小心。
这里有很多眼睛。你知道我的意思，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Let's go the <NAVI>[Document Storage Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我们去<NAVI>[文件仓库]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Go to the <NAVI>[Document Storage Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, go quickly before someone notice you.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
快去<NAVI>[文件仓库]<INFO>lhz_in01,32,264,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>，赶在有人注意到你之前。

scripts.text:
[Gray]
Don't you have something else to do.
scripts.translation:
[格雷]
你难道没有别的事要做吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Hello, this is the document storage room.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你好，这里是文件仓库。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Ah! I see. You're looking for Patrick Kaufmann's transfer logs?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
啊，我明白了。你们是在找帕特里克·考夫曼的转移记录？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Yes, that's why we're here. Have you found what we're looking for?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
是的，这就是我们来这里的原因。你找到我们要找的东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Patrick Kaufmann. Transfer Code 12-4332.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
帕特里克·考夫曼。转移代码12-4332。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
He was working as part of the facility maintenance department and then transferred to a new facility.
It says the director, McDonald, came here directly and gave a list of people to transfer.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
他原本在设施维护部门工作，后来被转移到了新的设施。
记录显示，总监麦克唐纳亲自来到这里，并给了一份需要转移的人员名单。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Do you still have that list?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那份名单还在吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Oh, that? Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[职员]
哦，那个？请稍等...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Oh, there it is. I found it.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
哦，在这里。我找到了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Daisy, can you compare the list please.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
黛西，请你对比一下这份名单。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hmm.. there are many overlap with the names from both lists. I expected as such... but I'm confused.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
嗯...两份名单上有很多重叠的名字。我预料到了...但我还是感到困惑。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Does Kaufmann still work at McDonald's laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
考夫曼还在麦克唐纳的实验室工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Well... the fact is, some of the facility maintenance employees work outside of the labs.
Patrick was from the same department, so maybe it was the same for him.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
嗯...事实是，有些设施维护部门的员工会在实验室之外工作。
帕特里克来自同一个部门，所以也许他也是这样。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I've been told we are not allowed to transfer people until at least a whole year, but what is the reason why Kaufmann was transferred?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我听说，除非至少满一年，否则不允许转移人员，但考夫曼被转移的原因是什么？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Well... there's reason to do that here. Once a request is received from the lab, we approve it. It's a top priority.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
嗯...这里确实有理由这样做。一旦收到实验室的请求，我们就会批准。这是最高优先级。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
So where is Kaufmann right now?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那么考夫曼现在在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
As I told you before, I work around the clock... there are many laboratories here and there, I'm not sure which ones are still operational or not.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
正如我之前所说，我全天候工作...这里有很多实验室，我不确定哪些还在运作，哪些已经关闭了。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
We don't keep track of all the trips and movements inside the headquarters. I hear a lot, though.
The detailed records can be found inside the lab he is in, or another lab perhaps.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
我们不会记录总部内部所有的行程和移动。不过我听到过很多消息。
详细的记录可以在他所在的实验室，或者另一个实验室里找到。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
How was his vacations? Did he rest well?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他的假期过得怎么样？休息得好吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
On vacation... he has already used all of his days. Well... he drove out at the end of the year.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
关于休假...他所有的假期都已经用完了。嗯...他在年底就离开了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And where did he go during his vacations? I already know the answer, but there is someone here who doesn't believe me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
那他休假期间去了哪里？我已经知道答案了，但这里有个人不相信我。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
We do not control how and where the employees spend their private time.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
我们不会干涉员工如何以及在何处度过他们的私人时间。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Just one more check. Marcus Holzman is on the list. Where is he working now?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
再确认一下。马库斯·霍尔茨曼在名单上。他现在在哪里工作？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let's see, Marcus Holzman? Wait...
scripts.translation:
[职员]
让我看看，马库斯·霍尔茨曼？等等...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Well, Holzman went to Sinclair's laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
嗯，霍尔茨曼去了辛克莱的实验室。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Did he use all of his vacations as well?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他也用完了所有的假期吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Yes... He drove out at the end of the year and use all of his vacations days...
scripts.translation:
[职员]
是的...他在年底就离开了，并且用完了所有的假期...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Where is the laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
实验室在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Let's see... the lab is on the outside of Einbroch's outer zone.
McDonald lab is located at ^0000FFSector 01 - Section 95-146 in the Einbroch Mountains^000000 and Sinclair's lab is located at Zone 11 - Sector 45-156 in the Einbroch Mountains.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
让我看看...实验室位于艾音布罗克外围区域之外。
麦当劳实验室位于^0000FF艾音布罗克山脉 01区 - 95-146号^000000，辛克莱实验室位于艾音布罗克山脉 11区 - 45-156号。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
And there it goes. Of course. I also know the answer, but I'll ask you anyway, are Patrick and Marcus still working at Rekenber?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
果然如此。当然了。我也知道答案，但我还是要问你们，帕特里克和马库斯还在雷肯伯格工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Of course. They are being paid for work. If you leave, you wouldn't get paid anymore, right?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
当然。他们是在领取工作报酬。如果你离职了，就不会再拿到薪水了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Of course, that's common sense~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
当然，这是常识~

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Now let's head to these new laboratories. There's probably a lot more we can find out over there.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
现在让我们去这些新的实验室吧。在那里我们大概能发现更多线索。

scripts.text: How are we doing this?
scripts.translation: 我们要怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We can all go together. We came here for this reason.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们可以一起去。我们来这里就是为了这个。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
How about we save some time and share information afterwards? Let's split and meet again at a specific location.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
为了节省时间，我们之后可以分享信息。让我们分头行动，然后在指定地点汇合。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
That's a good idea. Then me and you will go to Sinclair's laboratory together.
The adventurer will go to McDonald's laboratory with the VIP. When we finish the investigation, we'll meet you back over at McDonald's lab.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这是个好主意。那么我和你一起去辛克莱的实验室。
冒险者会和VIP一起去麦当劳实验室。调查结束后，我们在麦当劳实验室汇合。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Why? Why am I going with you? Isn't it better for me to go back with the Vice President?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
为什么？为什么我要和你一起去？我陪副总裁回去不是更好吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Have you forgotten? The Vice PResident wants to do this operation as unbiased as possible.
Would you believe the findings of me and the adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你忘了吗？副总裁希望这次行动尽可能保持公正。
你会相信我和冒险者的调查结果吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you want to give the Vice President a reason to be suspicious? We can't allow that?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你想给副总裁留下可疑的把柄吗？那是不允许的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'm fine with Daisy's idea. It makes the most sense.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我同意黛西的主意。这样最合理。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Vice President! The reason I'm here is to protect you!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
副总裁！我留在这里是为了保护您！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I won't say it twice.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我只说一次。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Let's go now. You're heading for the <NAVI>[McDonald Laboratory]<INFO>ein_fild01,95,146,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, wait for us when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们出发吧。你要去<NAVI>[麦当劳实验室]<INFO>ein_fild01,95,146,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>，调查结束后在那里等我们。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Please have a look. If you need anything, let me know!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
请过目。如果您需要什么，请告诉我！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
<NAVI>[McDonald Laboratory]<INFO>ein_fild01,95,146,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is located in Einbroch, at the outer zone. Please be careful, it is a dangerous area.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
<NAVI>[麦当劳实验室]<INFO>ein_fild01,95,146,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>位于艾音布罗克的外围区域。请注意安全，那里很危险。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
If you have a document or a book to find, please go see the staff member at the reception.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
如果您需要查找文件或书籍，请去接待处咨询工作人员。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
This place is restricted from outsiders, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[实验室职员]
此处禁止外人进入，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Hello. Okay, you're busy so that you don't know when someone died? So what happened? Don't you think its a big deal?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你好。好吧，你忙得连有人死了都不知道？那到底发生了什么？你不觉得这是大事吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Everyone, please come out.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
大家，请出来。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Hello, Med. I've been looking forward to meeting you again.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你好，梅德。我很期待再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Med]
Aas? Oh my, is it really you Aas? Are you okay? What are you doing here? Are you go to question someone who's betrayed us and changed sides?
scripts.translation:
[梅德]
阿斯？天哪，真的是你吗，阿斯？你没事吧？你在这里做什么？你是来抓那些背叛我们、改换门庭的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Med]
Are you going to arrest these traitors, cruelly torture them, and make them reveal all their sins?
This is like a spy novel!
scripts.translation:
[梅德]
你是要逮捕这些叛徒，残酷地折磨他们，让他们吐露所有罪行吗？
这简直像间谍小说！

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I didn't come for that. Have you seen a facility maintenance employee by the name of Patrick Kaufmann? Where is he now?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我不是为此而来的。你见过一个叫帕特里克·考夫曼的设施维护员工吗？他现在在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Med]
Pa... who? Patrick Kaufmann? Who is that? I don't know... oh! have you asked <NAVI>[Sammy]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>?
Sammy would know more. He manages the workforce here. You should go meet him.
scripts.translation:
[梅德]
帕...谁？帕特里克·考夫曼？那是谁？我不认识...哦！你问过<NAVI>[萨米]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>了吗？
萨米会知道更多。他负责这里的人员管理。你应该去见见他。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Thank you for your help. Keep on rebuilding this lab.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
谢谢你的帮助。请继续重建这个实验室。

scripts.text:
[Med]
And would you like to tell me who you are?
scripts.translation:
[梅德]
还有，你能告诉我你是谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
These people don't even know the face of the Vice President they work for.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这些人甚至不知道他们服务的副总裁长什么样子。

scripts.text:
[Med]
Ah!! That's you, I'm so sorry! I'll do my best!
scripts.translation:
[梅德]
啊！！原来是你，对不起！我会尽力的！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
We should go <NAVI>[here]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> now~
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我们现在应该去<NAVI>[这里]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>~

scripts.text:
[Med]
If you want more information, you should ask <NAVI>[Sammy]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> at the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[梅德]
如果您想了解更多资讯，应该去入口询问<NAVI>[萨米]<INFO>rgsr_in,12,46,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
This place is restricted from outsiders, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[实验室职员]
此处禁止外人进入，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
What are you doing here? You can't be here unless you have an appointment.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你们在这里做什么？没有预约是不能待在这里的。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Hey, Sammy. Could I ask you a few questions?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
嘿，萨米。我能问你几个问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
Aas? What are you doing here...?
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
阿斯？你在这里做什么...？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Good afternoon. We want to ask you a few questions.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
下午好。我们想问你几个问题。

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
What do you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
你们想问什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
This is the Vice President, here with us.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这位是副总裁，他/她和我们在一起。

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
Vice President?
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
副总裁？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes, this is the Vice President, Kaya Tos.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是的，这位是卡雅·托斯副总裁。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Nice to meet you, I'm Kaya Tos.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
很高兴见到你，我是卡雅·托斯。

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
Oh my, Vice President. What are you doing in such a place... oh, what do you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
天哪，副总裁。您怎么会在这样的地方...哦，您想知道什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh wow, look at the attitude change. All we had to do was say the magic words : Vice President.
That was too easy.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哇哦，看看这态度的转变。我们只需要说出那个“魔法词”：副总裁。
这也太容易了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I should probably use it more often from now on?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
我以后应该更经常使用这个招数？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'd like to know where Patrick Kaufmann is. He is a facility maintenance employee who was sent here.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我想知道帕特里克·考夫曼在哪里。他是一名被派到这里的设施维护员工。

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
Pa... Patrick Kaufmann... Patrick... Well... Ah! I remember!
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
帕...帕特里克·考夫曼...帕特里克...嗯...啊！我想起来了！

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
... and then he was sent to another laboratory.
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
...然后他被调到了另一个实验室。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You aren't supposed to relocate new employees for at least a whole year, why are you constantly asking for more workforce?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你们不应该在至少一年内调动新员工，为什么你们总是要求增加人手？

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
Yeah...? Why are we being sent so many? I have ^0000FFnever asked or more manpower in the building^000000. When new people arrive here, I assume they're simply a transfer.
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
是吗？为什么我们要被派来这么多人？我^0000FF从未要求过增加大楼里的人手^000000。当新人来到这里时，我假设他们只是调任过来的。

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
So when Pat came here, I thought he was also a transfer. Especially at the time, because of the new research facility, the maintenance and logistic department teams...
^0000FFwere transferring people a lot.^000000
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
所以当帕特来的时候，我以为他也是调任过来的。特别是当时，因为新的研究设施，维护和后勤部门的团队...
^0000FF经常调动人员。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Where is the location of the transfer laboratory?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
转移实验室的位置在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
I don't know the exact location.
It's somewhere at the ^0000FFEinbroch's outer zone.^000000 I've heard many new facilities involve dangerous experiments that can't be done in the city, so workforce is sent outside.
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
我不知道确切的位置。
它在^0000FF艾音布罗克的外围区域^000000。我听说许多新设施涉及危险的实验，无法在城市内进行，所以人员被派到了城外。

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
But... maybe... was there another reason for the transfers? What...
What happened to the people?
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
但是...也许...转移还有别的原因吗？
那些...那些人后来怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
A new laboratory... I couldn't investigate it. It's a new laboratory that needs a lot of people, but I wasn't able to find it. What do you think? Can you smell us getting closer?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
新的实验室...我无法调查它。这是一个需要很多人手的新实验室，但我没能找到它。你觉得呢？你能感觉到我们离真相越来越近了吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
This is certainly not in the papers I've received. There were only mentions of departures and few transfers. All the details were missing.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
这确实不在我收到的文件中。文件里只提到了离职和少量的调动，所有细节都缺失了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
They wrote it like that on purpose,
someone with enough suspicious would have figured out the truth.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
他们是故意那样写的，
任何足够多疑的人都会发现真相。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Perhaps someone didn't want you to learn the truth and deliberately removed those details. Otherwise it would have been shown in the original documents.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
也许有人不想让你知道真相，故意删除了那些细节。否则，原始文件中应该会有记载。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
A new facility... I must find out where it is. There might be more things we don't know about.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
新的设施...我必须找到它的位置。可能还有更多我们不知道的事情。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
You keep going on and on and on. If someone dies, I have to confirm it with my own eyes.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你一直在喋喋不休。如果有人死了，我必须亲眼确认。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Let's get more information from the <NAVI>[Office]<INFO>lhz_in01,80,210,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
让我们去<NAVI>[办公室]<INFO>lhz_in01,80,210,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>获取更多信息。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Are you going to the Human Resources?
I've already been there.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你要去人力资源部？
我已经去过了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
How deeply did you investigate the Enterprise?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你调查企业调查得有多深入？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oh no~ you still think I'm a liar.
Where else will you find someone as trustworthy as I am?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
哎呀~ 你还觉得我在撒谎。
除了我，你还能找到谁这么值得信赖呢？

scripts.text: What did you just say?
scripts.translation: 你刚才说什么？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
One of the employee here said that one of my very distant relative passed away and left a big legacy.
I wasn't able to reach him, and then I came here looking for what was left for me.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
这里的一个员工说，我的一位远房亲戚去世了，留下了一大笔遗产。
我没能联系到他，然后我就来这里寻找留给我的东西。

scripts.text: You believed him?
scripts.translation: 你相信他？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Why not? Does the adventurer have any relatives? I don't know...
Romance and thrills, hehe. We've always waited for this dream to happen.
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
为什么不呢？冒险者有亲戚吗？我不知道...
浪漫和刺激，呵呵。我们一直等待这个梦想成真。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Oh...

[Lazy]
Does your guard know some romance?
scripts.translation:
[懒散]
你的卫兵知道一些浪漫故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
There's no time for this, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
没时间说这些了，走吧。

scripts.text:
[Sammy]
I didn't mean to cover up anything, it's just what I heard. Did everyone else went to the <NAVI>[Office]<INFO>lhz_in01,80,210,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>?
scripts.translation:
[萨米]
我没有想隐瞒什么，只是听到了这些。大家都去<NAVI>[办公室]<INFO>lhz_in01,80,210,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>了吗？

scripts.text:
[Staff]
What are you doing here? You can't be here unless you have an appointment.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
你们在这里做什么？没有预约是不能待在这里的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Do you know why we're here?
Daisy, what are you thinking?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你知道我们为什么在这里吗？
黛西，你在想什么？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
